course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: A new pickup truck has a first cost of Tk.8000 and is expected to last 6 years with a Tk. 1,300 salvage value. The operating cost of the vehicle is expected to be Tk.1700 the first year, increasing by 11% per year thereafter. Determine the equivalent present cost of the truck if the interest rate is 8% per year.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
